stories.title: Lamar headed to IR with 'potentially' season-ending thumb injury
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson needs to have surgery on his injured right thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, coach Jesse Minter said.

stories.title: Jones backs Schottenheimer, says Cowboys let coach down in loss
stories.summary: Despite matching the largest blown fourth-quarter lead in team history, Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said the loss to Arizona will not trigger a coaching change.

stories.title: Barkley receives assurances he won't be dealt, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'
stories.summary: Speaking after Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Washington Commanders, Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley told reporters he has received assurances from the front office that he will remain with the club beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

stories.title: Colts' Steichen to 'evaluate everything,' including QB, after 42-7 drubbing
stories.summary: After the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday, the Colts coach Shane Steichen left open the possibility of significant changes, including at quarterback.

stories.title: Steelers answer Verse's trash talk with big win: 'Should have kept his mouth shut'
stories.summary: The Steelers got the last word after Browns defensive end Jared Verse's trash talk ahead of Sunday's matchup.
